import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")


def haversine(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2):
    R = 6371
    dlat = np.radians(lat2 - lat1)
    dlon = np.radians(lon2 - lon1)
    a = (
        np.sin(dlat / 2) ** 2
        + np.cos(np.radians(lat1)) * np.cos(np.radians(lat2)) * np.sin(dlon / 2) ** 2
    )
    c = 2 * np.arctan2(np.sqrt(a), np.sqrt(1 - a))
    return R * c


def manhattan(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2):
    return abs(lat1 - lat2) + abs(lon1 - lon2)


print("Loading training data...")
# Load only a subset to stay within time limits
train = pd.read_csv("./input/labels.csv", nrows=500000)

# Clean data early (same as best model)
train = train[train["fare_amount"] > 0]
train = train[train["fare_amount"] < 500]
train = train[train["passenger_count"] >= 0]
train = train[train["passenger_count"] <= 6]

# Filter NYC area coordinates (same as best model)
mask = (
    (train["pickup_latitude"] >= 40.5)
    & (train["pickup_latitude"] <= 41.5)
    & (train["pickup_longitude"] >= -74.5)
    & (train["pickup_longitude"] <= -73.5)
    & (train["dropoff_latitude"] >= 40.5)
    & (train["dropoff_latitude"] <= 41.5)
    & (train["dropoff_longitude"] >= -74.5)
    & (train["dropoff_longitude"] <= -73.5)
)
train = train[mask].copy()
print(f"After cleaning: {len(train)} rows")

# Feature engineering (same as best model)
print("Engineering features...")
train["pickup_datetime"] = pd.to_datetime(train["pickup_datetime"])
train["pickup_hour"] = train["pickup_datetime"].dt.hour
train["pickup_dayofweek"] = train["pickup_datetime"].dt.dayofweek
train["pickup_month"] = train["pickup_datetime"].dt.month

train["distance_haversine"] = haversine(
    train["pickup_latitude"],
    train["pickup_longitude"],
    train["dropoff_latitude"],
    train["dropoff_longitude"],
)
train["distance_manhattan"] = manhattan(
    train["pickup_latitude"],
    train["pickup_longitude"],
    train["dropoff_latitude"],
    train["dropoff_longitude"],
)
train["abs_diff_lat"] = abs(train["dropoff_latitude"] - train["pickup_latitude"])
train["abs_diff_lon"] = abs(train["dropoff_longitude"] - train["pickup_longitude"])

manhattan_center = (40.7812, -73.9665)
train["pickup_dist_to_center"] = haversine(
    train["pickup_latitude"], train["pickup_longitude"], *manhattan_center
)
train["dropoff_dist_to_center"] = haversine(
    train["dropoff_latitude"], train["dropoff_longitude"], *manhattan_center
)

# Remove zero distance
train = train[train["distance_haversine"] > 0.01].copy()

# Sort by index to ensure temporal hold-out split
train = train.sort_index()
train = train.reset_index(drop=True)

feature_cols = [
    "pickup_hour",
    "pickup_dayofweek",
    "pickup_month",
    "passenger_count",
    "distance_haversine",
    "distance_manhattan",
    "abs_diff_lat",
    "abs_diff_lon",
    "pickup_dist_to_center",
    "dropoff_dist_to_center",
]

X = train[feature_cols].values
y = train["fare_amount"].values

# Temporal hold-out: last 10% for validation
split_idx = int(len(X) * 0.9)
X_train, X_val = X[:split_idx], X[split_idx:]
y_train, y_val = y[:split_idx], y[split_idx:]
print(f"Train size: {len(X_train)}, Val size: {len(X_val)}")

# LightGBM with improved params for better performance
params = {
    "objective": "regression",
    "metric": "rmse",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 50,  # Increased from 31 for more capacity
    "learning_rate": 0.1,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "min_data_in_leaf": 20,  # Added to prevent overfitting
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
    "n_jobs": -1,
}

# Train with early stopping
print("Training LightGBM model...")
lgb_train = lgb.Dataset(X_train, y_train)
lgb_val = lgb.Dataset(X_val, y_val, reference=lgb_train)

model = lgb.train(
    params,
    lgb_train,
    num_boost_round=300,  # More rounds with improved params
    valid_sets=[lgb_train, lgb_val],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=20), lgb.log_evaluation(period=0)],
)

# Validate
y_pred_val = model.predict(X_val)
rmse = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_val, y_pred_val))
print(f"Validation RMSE: {rmse:.4f}")

# Load test data and generate predictions
print("Loading test data and generating predictions...")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

test["pickup_datetime"] = pd.to_datetime(test["pickup_datetime"])
test["pickup_hour"] = test["pickup_datetime"].dt.hour
test["pickup_dayofweek"] = test["pickup_datetime"].dt.dayofweek
test["pickup_month"] = test["pickup_datetime"].dt.month

test["distance_haversine"] = haversine(
    test["pickup_latitude"],
    test["pickup_longitude"],
    test["dropoff_latitude"],
    test["dropoff_longitude"],
)
test["distance_manhattan"] = manhattan(
    test["pickup_latitude"],
    test["pickup_longitude"],
    test["dropoff_latitude"],
    test["dropoff_longitude"],
)
test["abs_diff_lat"] = abs(test["dropoff_latitude"] - test["pickup_latitude"])
test["abs_diff_lon"] = abs(test["dropoff_longitude"] - test["pickup_longitude"])
test["pickup_dist_to_center"] = haversine(
    test["pickup_latitude"], test["pickup_longitude"], *manhattan_center
)
test["dropoff_dist_to_center"] = haversine(
    test["dropoff_latitude"], test["dropoff_longitude"], *manhattan_center
)

X_test = test[feature_cols].values
test_preds = model.predict(X_test)

# Create submission
submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")
submission["fare_amount"] = test_preds
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Final RMSE: {rmse:.4f}")
